title: Christine Winther Bang
text:
I’m a postdoc at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen, where I’m working in the Copenhagen Causality Lab.
Previously, I was a PhD student in the Statistical Methods for Causal Inference group at the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology - BIPS in Bremen.
My research interests include graphical models and causal inference, and my current work focuses on causal discovery.
Contact: cwb [at] math [dot] ku [dot] dk

title: Research

Selected publications
Christine W Bang and Vanessa Didelez. “Constraint-based causal discovery with tiered background knowledge and incomplete information”. Proceedings of the Fourth Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 275:1116-1146, 2025 (link).
